scope: private aggregate manifests and results (structure and hashes only)

rules: An aggregate may claim accuracy only when its metric disposition is VALID_CASESET_ACCURACY and every required validation is evidenced.
Case-set accuracy must be labelled case-set; population or universal accuracy additionally requires a frozen representative sampling design.
Reference agreement is not accuracy and must name the reference extractor or source.
NOT_SCOREABLE metrics may be emitted as diagnostics only with the literal label NOT SCOREABLE.
Unknown, agent, auto, provisional, needs_review, rejected, and blank statuses are never silently admitted as human gold.
A score set must contain one row per normalized-content fingerprint and one least-edited upstream pstream per work family.
Gold, scorer, corpus manifest, and prediction artifacts must be content-addressed in every report.

mike_private_manifest.finding: Byte-unique, but no enforced work-family, derivative, or pstream identity.

mike_split_review.finding: No admissible accepted human gold rows.

alr_fast_split_manual_gold.finding: Human review product, but current aggregate is failure-selected, duplicate-weighted, and the loader does not enforce human provenance.

alr_supra_candidates.finding: Derived from production/frozen outputs; the Martin slice adds explicitly provenance-tagged agent adjudications and remains provisional, not human gold.

alr_field_provisional.finding: Provisional and inherited auto/agent fields; not accepted per-field gold.

legalpdf_docx_linking_synthetic.finding: Hand-authored synthetic contract fixture; the implementation was tuned after a failure on this same fixture.

legalpdf_docx_reference_pilot.finding: DOCX-extractor silver reference; no manually adjudicated rendered-PDF regions.

locked_footnote_pairing_set.finding: Internally locked with zero validation issues, but most markers originate in canonical automatic pages; only provenance-confirmed manual pages can support human case-set claims.

docx_corpus.manifest.input_documents.definition: Number of candidate DOCX paths considered before exclusions.

docx_corpus.manifest.unique_documents.definition: Number of staged documents after exact file-byte SHA-256 deduplication.

docx_corpus.manifest.duplicate_aliases.definition: Number of candidate paths whose file-byte SHA-256 duplicates a staged file.

docx_corpus.manifest.skipped_candidates.definition: Number of candidate paths excluded by configured selection or path rules.

docx_corpus.manifest.derivative_pruned.definition: Number of paths rejected by filename-token derivative heuristics.

docx_corpus.manifest.feature_coverage.*.definition: Number of staged documents with a positive static feature count for the named feature.

contracts.gold_creation: Manual upstream selection plus exact-byte deduplication and filename-token pruning.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: No correctness gold is involved. Byte deduplication misses renamed/edited derivatives and same-work versions; filename rules are neither semantic nor exhaustive.
contracts.failure_semantics: A clean count proves only byte uniqueness under the scanned paths; it does not prove one work, one pstream, or least-edited provenance.
contracts.uncertainty: No inferential uncertainty is defined.
required_validation: Add immutable work_family_id, pstream_id, source_repository, source_revision, edition_role, and selection_reason.
Require exactly one row per work_family_id and pstream_id.
Require edition_role=least_edited_upstream and reject chief, galley, camera-ready, annotated, clean-copy, returned, revised, and derived products.
Reject both byte duplicates and normalized-content duplicates before scoring.

docx_corpus.scan.documents.definition: Number of distinct resolved manifest paths processed.

docx_corpus.scan.documents_parsed.definition: Count of document results with an empty error field.

docx_corpus.scan.document_errors.definition: Count of document results with a non-empty error field.

docx_corpus.scan.document_feature_counts.definition: Number of manifest documents whose named integer feature is greater than zero; not the number of feature occurrences.

docx_corpus.scan.footnotes.definition: Number of extracted DOCX footnote cases.

docx_corpus.scan.unique_footnote_texts.definition: Number of unique SHA-256 fingerprints of whitespace-normalized, case-folded footnote text.

docx_corpus.scan.citations_detected.definition: Sum of citation regex detections over parsed documents.

docx_corpus.scan.conservative_complete.definition: Number of conservative deterministic predictions with status complete.

docx_corpus.scan.conservative_coverage.definition: conservative_complete divided by max(1, extracted footnote cases).

docx_corpus.scan.conservative_character_.definition: Complete conservative predictions whose normalized source core differs from the joined output core; core removes whitespace and semicolons.

docx_corpus.scan.recall_first_complete.definition: Number of recall-first deterministic predictions with status complete.

docx_corpus.scan.recall_first_character_.definition: Complete recall-first predictions whose normalized source core differs from the joined output core.

docx_corpus.scan.conservative_reason_cou.definition: Frequency of each conservative abstention or decision reason emitted by the deterministic splitter.

docx_corpus.scan.elapsed_seconds.definition: Wall-clock duration of the scan call.

contracts.gold_creation: Direct measurement of parser and splitter outputs.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The parser/splitter produces the values being counted. Character neutrality uses a deliberately lossy core and is not semantic correctness.
contracts.failure_semantics: Parse errors and character-core differences are failures of the stated invariant; all other counts are observations, not correctness.
contracts.uncertainty: Elapsed time is a single wall-clock observation; counts are exact for the frozen manifest.
required_validation: Verify manifest hash and zero parse errors.
Report unique text count alongside case count.
Do not rename coverage or character neutrality as accuracy.

docx_corpus.score.accepted_cases.definition: Number of gold rows whose status case-folds exactly to accepted.

docx_corpus.score.arm.cases.definition: Number of admitted gold rows in the arm denominator.

docx_corpus.score.arm.attempted.definition: Count with prediction status complete and at least one non-empty normalized part.

docx_corpus.score.arm.strict_exact.definition: Count whose actual parts equal the canonical partition after normalization and whose joined core is character-neutral.

docx_corpus.score.arm.tolerant_exact.definition: Count whose character-neutral actual parts equal any accepted partition after normalization.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.abstain.definition: Count with no complete, non-empty prediction.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.character.definition: Count attempted where normalized source core differs from joined output core.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.exact.definition: Count matching the canonical accepted partition with character neutrality.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.acceptabl.definition: Count matching a non-canonical accepted partition with character neutrality.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.under_spl.definition: Character-neutral attempted count whose part count is below every accepted partition count.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.over_spli.definition: Character-neutral attempted count whose part count exceeds every accepted partition count.

docx_corpus.score.arm.outcomes.boundary_.definition: Remaining character-neutral attempted count that matches no accepted partition.

docx_corpus.score.arm.by_tag.*.definition: The same case, attempt, exact, and outcome counts stratified by case tag; a case can contribute to multiple tags.

contracts.gold_creation: Balanced challenge sampling from unique normalized footnote texts; rows require later human partition adjudication.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: All 80 current rows are provisional and have empty expected partitions. The scorer now enforces human provenance, content uniqueness, one least-edited upstream pstream, and exact prediction coverage, but no current row satisfies the semantic-gold contract.
contracts.failure_semantics: The scorer correctly refuses a file with zero accepted rows. Missing prediction rows become abstentions.
contracts.uncertainty: No interval or population inference is valid for the balanced challenge design.
required_validation: Independently adjudicate canonical and acceptable partitions.
Store reviewer identity class, adjudication timestamp, guideline version, and provenance evidence separate from model output.
Enforce exact accepted status plus required human provenance.
Freeze one normalized-content fingerprint per case and one least-edited upstream pstream per work family.
Require exact gold/prediction ID bijection and non-empty expected parts.

docx_corpus.score.arm.strict_exact_95ci.definition: Wilson 95% interval for strict exact successes over cases, emitted only when sampling_design is exactly representative.

docx_corpus.score.arm.tolerant_exact_95c.definition: Wilson 95% interval for tolerant exact successes over cases, emitted only when sampling_design is exactly representative.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.tolerant_wi.definition: Paired cases where an arm is tolerant-exact and the baseline is not.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.tolerant_lo.definition: Paired cases where the baseline is tolerant-exact and an arm is not.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.paired_sign.definition: Two-sided exact sign-test p-value over non-tied tolerant wins and losses, only for representative sampling.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.tolerant_ac.definition: Arm tolerant_exact_accuracy minus baseline tolerant_exact_accuracy on the same admitted cases.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.under_split.definition: Arm under-split count minus baseline under-split count.

docx_corpus.score.comparison.character_d.definition: Arm character-drift count minus baseline character-drift count.

contracts.gold_creation: Same as mike_docx_split_gold_score.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The current challenge sample is deliberately balanced, not representative, and has no accepted rows.
contracts.failure_semantics: The current scorer nulls intervals and p-values for non-representative designs; deltas remain descriptive.
contracts.uncertainty: Not estimable for the current gold.
required_validation: Freeze an independently drawn representative sample and inclusion probabilities.
Complete all gold requirements in mike_docx_split_gold_score.
Pre-register primary endpoint and comparison before evaluating arms.

alr.fast_split.total_cases.definition: Number of admitted gold rows evaluated.

alr.fast_split.exact_count.definition: Count whose normalized output parts equal the canonical expected partition.

alr.fast_split.strict_exact_accuracy.definition: Canonical exact count divided by admitted cases.

alr.fast_split.tolerant_exact_count.definition: Count matching the canonical or an explicitly accepted alternative partition with core character loss/gain neutrality.

alr.fast_split.tolerant_exact_accuracy.definition: Tolerant exact count divided by admitted cases.

alr.fast_split.under_split_count.definition: Count with fewer actual parts than the canonical expected partition.

alr.fast_split.over_split_count.definition: Count with more actual parts than the canonical expected partition.

alr.fast_split.boundary_mismatch_count.definition: Count with canonical part count but no exact accepted partition match.

alr.fast_split.core_char_exact.definition: Count whose normalized joined output core exactly equals the normalized source core in order.

contracts.gold_creation: A human corrected split/join boundaries in an application-style review artifact; character-changing rows were routed to needs_review.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The current loader excludes only needs_review/provisional, so unknown statuses can enter. Accepted does not enforce human provenance. Twenty-five normalized-text duplicate rows alter weighting, and cases were failure-mined.
contracts.failure_semantics: Exact/boundary outcomes are meaningful only after strict status, provenance, content deduplication, and one-pstream validation.
contracts.uncertainty: No population inference: the case set is failure-selected.
contracts.interpretation: Potential case-set partition accuracy; current aggregate is not compliant.
required_validation: Reject every status except exact accepted.
Require human adjudicator provenance and guideline version.
Deduplicate normalized text fingerprints before scoring.
Enforce one least-edited upstream pstream per work family.
Independently re-review a stratified sample and publish disagreement/adjudication counts.
Use min/max accepted partition sizes for under/over, not canonical size alone.

alr.fast_split.fuzzy_accuracy.definition: Mean of the best per-position SequenceMatcher ratios against accepted partitions, comparing absent positions with empty strings.

alr.fast_split.char_neutral_accuracy.definition: Fraction whose normalized joined output has the same character length as the normalized source; content need not match.

alr.fast_split.core_loss_gain_neutral.definition: Fraction whose normalized source and output cores have equal character multisets; order is ignored.

alr.fast_split.nonempty_field_rates.*.definition: Fraction of output objects where the named field is populated with the expected broad type.

alr.fast_split.mean_latency_seconds.definition: Arithmetic mean of per-case elapsed wall time in one benchmark run.

contracts.gold_creation: Computed from output shape, string similarity, or timing.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: SequenceMatcher is not an adjudicated correctness rule; field presence is not field correctness; length or multiset equality is not exact preservation.
contracts.failure_semantics: Only the literal shape/similarity/invariant is measured.
contracts.uncertainty: No intervals; latency is not repeated or environment-normalized.
required_validation: Rename char_neutral_accuracy to equal_normalized_length_rate.
Rename core_loss_gain_neutral to equal_core_character_multiset_rate.
Do not call field presence or SequenceMatcher similarity accuracy.

alr.deterministic.field_agreement_with_c.definition: Agreement of deterministic output fields with a frozen production/model output on aligned replacement-eligible cases.

alr.deterministic.weighted_loss.definition: Configured utility score: 10 times under-splits plus 3 times boundary mismatches plus over-splits.

alr.replay.partition_agreement.definition: Exact or tolerant partition equality with frozen production output.

alr.replay.field_agreement.*.definition: Field equality with frozen production output.

alr.replay.call_savings.definition: Frozen model calls avoided by the replay policy under its eligibility assumptions.

alr.replay.tokens_avoided.*.definition: Frozen token totals attributed to calls avoided by replay.

contracts.gold_creation: Frozen production outputs are used as comparator, not adjudicated truth.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The comparator is the system being replaced; inherited errors count as agreement and improvements count as disagreement.
contracts.failure_semantics: Disagreement means only deviation from frozen behavior. Weighted loss is a chosen utility, not error probability.
contracts.uncertainty: No population inference or live model variability is represented.
required_validation: Always name the frozen comparator hash.
Never label agreement, regression, weighted loss, or projected savings as correctness.
Use an independent gold arm for any accuracy comparison.

legalpdf.score.text.characters.definition: Number of characters in normalized DOCX-reference paragraph text after footnote-marker removal.

legalpdf.score.text.character_edits.definition: Edit distance from normalized DOCX-reference text to candidate text.

legalpdf.score.text.cer.definition: character_edits divided by max(1, reference character count).

legalpdf.score.text.words.definition: Whitespace-token count in normalized DOCX-reference text.

legalpdf.score.text.word_edits.definition: Edit distance between DOCX-reference and candidate whitespace-token sequences.

legalpdf.score.text.wer.definition: word_edits divided by max(1, reference word count).

contracts.gold_creation: Paragraph text is mechanically extracted from DOCX OOXML, then compared with text parsed from exported/degraded PDF.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The reference is independent of PDF OCR but is silver: DOCX extraction and normalization can omit rendered content and cannot adjudicate PDF-only layout.
contracts.failure_semantics: Edits mean disagreement with normalized DOCX reference, not necessarily incorrect rendered-PDF recovery.
contracts.uncertainty: Edit-distance backend can be rapidfuzz, python-Levenshtein, or an approximate difflib fallback and must be reported.
required_validation: Pin and report the edit-distance backend.
Validate DOCX extraction against rendered pages on an independently adjudicated subset before calling CER/WER accuracy.
Keep each source profile paired and do not treat four derivatives as four independent documents.
Use one least-edited upstream DOCX pstream per work family.

legalpdf.score.order.matched_paragraphs.definition: Count of DOCX paragraphs whose normalized first 12 words equal a candidate paragraph signature.

legalpdf.score.order.pairwise_order_accu.definition: Increasing candidate-position pairs divided by comparable pairs among signature-matched paragraphs.

legalpdf.score.order.adjacent_order_reca.definition: Adjacent pairs in the matched list with increasing candidate positions divided by max(0, matched paragraphs minus one).

legalpdf.score.order.exact_position_accu.definition: Signature-matched paragraphs at the same zero-based index divided by matched paragraphs.

contracts.gold_creation: DOCX paragraph order is used as silver reference.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Candidate signatures overwrite collisions; unmatched paragraphs are excluded from accuracy denominators; repeated or short paragraphs can map incorrectly.
contracts.failure_semantics: A high value can coexist with missing, duplicated, or collision-overwritten paragraphs.
contracts.uncertainty: No collision rate, unmatched penalty, or interval is reported.
contracts.interpretation: The current order ratios are not valid accuracy metrics.
required_validation: Replace signature dictionary matching with a one-to-one alignment that preserves duplicates.
Penalize unmatched gold and candidate paragraphs.
Freeze independently verified reading-order IDs and report match coverage.
Test collision, duplicate-paragraph, omission, and insertion cases.

legalpdf.score.structure.gold_lines.definition: Number of unique line IDs named by gold regions.

legalpdf.score.structure.candidate_lines.definition: Number of candidate document lines keyed by line ID.

legalpdf.score.structure.covered_lines.definition: Count of line IDs common to gold and candidate.

legalpdf.score.structure.line_coverage.definition: covered_lines divided by gold_lines, or one when no gold lines exist.

legalpdf.score.structure.region_type_acc.definition: Correct region types on common line IDs divided by all gold line IDs.

legalpdf.score.structure.region_boundary.definition: Exact common (page, type, ordered line-ID tuple) regions divided by candidate regions.
Exact common regions divided by gold regions.
Harmonic mean of exact region boundary precision and recall.

legalpdf.score.structure.pairwise_line_o.definition: Correctly ordered pairs among candidate-observed gold line IDs divided by comparable observed pairs.

legalpdf.score.structure.exact_line_posi.definition: Equal IDs at zipped gold and observed positions divided by gold ordered line IDs.

contracts.gold_creation: Intended source is a frozen manual page-region and reading-order bundle; that bundle is absent.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Current DOCX-generated gold contains no regions. Pairwise order excludes missing lines; line IDs require a stable source-independent identity contract.
contracts.failure_semantics: No current region score can be produced from the audited pilot gold.
contracts.uncertainty: Undefined until a sample design and gold exist.
required_validation: Create and content-address manual region/type/order gold from rendered pages.
Require two-pass adjudication for ambiguous region boundaries.
Define stable line identity independent of the candidate parser.
Penalize missing and extra lines in order metrics.
Verify the referenced bundle exists and has zero validation issues.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.gold.definition: Number of unique DOCX-reference (enumerated label, occurrence) keys.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.candidate.definition: Number of unique candidate (label, occurrence) keys.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.matched.definition: Size of the intersection of DOCX-reference and candidate (label, occurrence) keys.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.precision.definition: matched keys divided by candidate keys.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.recall.definition: matched keys divided by gold keys.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.f1.definition: Harmonic mean of key precision and recall.

legalpdf.score.footnotes.mean_body_simil.definition: Mean normalized SequenceMatcher ratio of body text over matched label/occurrence keys.

contracts.gold_creation: DOCX OOXML footnotes are enumerated by reference order; occurrence is fixed to one.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Matching label/occurrence does not prove the correct marker-body pair; numbering is reconstructed, and body similarity has no adjudicated threshold.
contracts.failure_semantics: These are agreement with reconstructed DOCX keys, not independently verified pairing accuracy.
contracts.uncertainty: No intervals; similarity is heuristic.
required_validation: Use frozen marker and body IDs with an independently verified pairing relation for accuracy.
Test duplicate labels, repeated occurrence, missing markers, and swapped bodies.
Report key match and body correctness separately.

legalpdf.score.propositions.mean_sentenc.definition: Mean normalized SequenceMatcher ratio between heuristic DOCX sentence-at-marker text and candidate sentence proposition over matched footnotes.

legalpdf.score.propositions.mean_passage.definition: Mean normalized SequenceMatcher ratio between DOCX passage-since-prior-marker text and candidate passage over matched footnotes.

contracts.gold_creation: Sentence and passage strings are heuristically sliced from DOCX paragraphs around marker positions.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The reference boundary is produced by the benchmark heuristic, not human proposition pairing gold.
contracts.failure_semantics: Similarity measures reference-string agreement only.
contracts.uncertainty: No accepted threshold or intervals.
required_validation: Create independently adjudicated sentence and passage spans with stable offsets.
Score span overlap and exact pairing in addition to text similarity.
Define treatment of multi-paragraph and repeated-marker propositions.

legalpdf.score.citations.gold.definition: Number of unique citation strings detected by benchmark regexes in DOCX-reference text.

legalpdf.score.citations.candidate.definition: Number of unique citation strings detected by the same regexes in candidate text and footnotes.

legalpdf.score.citations.matched.definition: Set intersection size of regex-detected reference and candidate citations.

legalpdf.score.citations.recall.definition: matched regex strings divided by reference regex strings.

contracts.gold_creation: The same two benchmark regexes generate both the reference and candidate citation sets.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Complete scorer leakage: the detector defines the gold. Precision is absent and duplicate occurrences collapse into a set.
contracts.failure_semantics: A value measures survival of strings recognized by the shared regex, not citation extraction correctness.
contracts.uncertainty: Undefined against true citation population.
required_validation: Create independently annotated citation spans and canonical identities.
Score occurrence-level precision, recall, and F1.
Include citations outside the current regex grammar and hard negatives.

legalpdf.score.application_equivalence.t.definition: Number of text units returned by the ToA adapter for the candidate document.

legalpdf.score.codex.calls.definition: Recorded live model call count from document provenance.

legalpdf.score.codex.tokens.*.definition: Sum of the named token-usage field across repair records.

legalpdf.score.codex.repair.applied.definition: Number of repair records with status applied.

legalpdf.score.codex.repair.failed.definition: Number of repair records whose status is not applied.

legalpdf.score.codex.repair.retries.definition: Sum of max(0, attempts minus one) across repairs.

legalpdf.score.codex.repair.schema_valid.definition: Applied repair records divided by repair records; despite the name, this equates applied status with schema validity.

legalpdf.score.codex.repair.source_line_.definition: Same-ID, exact-text candidate lines after repair divided by max(baseline line count, repaired line count, one).
Number of line IDs in a separately parsed baseline document.
Number of line IDs in the repaired document.

contracts.gold_creation: Runtime provenance, local baseline comparison, and adapter output counts.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Baseline and repaired documents share parser identities. ToA unit count does not compare content. Applied status is not semantic validity.
contracts.failure_semantics: Only call accounting, status accounting, and same-ID text conservation are measured.
contracts.uncertainty: Latency and token use vary by run; no repetitions or cost schedule are frozen.
required_validation: Do not call toa_text_units application equivalence.
Separate schema validation from applied status.
For conservation accuracy, use immutable source line identities independently extracted from the candidate parser.
Report repeated latency distributions and frozen model/pricing metadata for cost claims.

legalpdf.run.wall_seconds.definition: Wall time for the primary parse and, for codex mode, its baseline parse, stopping before gold scoring.

legalpdf.run.peak_rss_bytes.definition: Maximum sampled process RSS during the primary parse at approximately 50 ms intervals.

legalpdf.run.errors.definition: Number or records of benchmark cases that raised an exception.

contracts.gold_creation: Runtime instrumentation.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Wall-time scope differs by mode; RSS sampling can miss short peaks and excludes child-process memory unless reflected in process RSS.
contracts.failure_semantics: An exception is a benchmark execution failure; timing and memory are observations.
contracts.uncertainty: Single-run measurements have no variance estimate.
required_validation: Use warmup plus repeated randomized runs.
Freeze hardware, software, exporter, model, and cache state.
Use identical timed scopes across arms and report median plus dispersion.

legalpdf.docx_linking.total.definition: Number of footnote plans returned by the model and iterated by the scorer.

legalpdf.docx_linking.strict_exact.definition: Count whose normalized parts equal the canonical partition.

legalpdf.docx_linking.tolerant_exact.definition: Count whose normalized parts equal any accepted partition; character neutrality is not required by this scorer.

legalpdf.docx_linking.character_neutral.definition: Count whose source core equals joined output core.

legalpdf.docx_linking.under_split.definition: Count with fewer parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.docx_linking.over_split.definition: Count with more parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.docx_linking.boundary_mismatch.definition: Count with canonical part count but no accepted partition match.

legalpdf.docx_linking.wall_seconds.definition: Wall time of one model strategy run.

legalpdf.docx_linking.telemetry.*.definition: Runtime model call, token, or strategy telemetry copied from the plan/run.

contracts.gold_creation: Twelve invented cases with hand-authored expected partitions.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The deterministic punctuation snap was changed after an observed model failure on the same fixture. The scorer iterates plan rows rather than enforcing exact expected/prediction ID bijection and tolerant exact omits character neutrality.
contracts.failure_semantics: The fixture can detect contract regressions but cannot support comparative or real-world accuracy.
contracts.uncertainty: Twelve chosen synthetic cases; no sampling inference.
required_validation: Require exact expected/prediction ID bijection.
Require character neutrality for tolerant exact.
Freeze a new untouched holdout after implementation changes.
Use accepted human real-document gold for model accuracy.
Reject all non-accepted statuses rather than excluding only provisional/needs_review.

alr.supra.total.definition: Number of admitted supra candidate rows.

alr.supra.exact_link_accuracy.definition: Fraction whose predicted link string exactly equals the candidate-gold link string.

alr.supra.base_link_accuracy.definition: Fraction whose link target before fragment/anchor equals the candidate-gold base target, with anchor errors tracked separately.

alr.supra.isolation_rate.definition: Fraction satisfying the benchmark's text-alignment isolation heuristic, typically similarity at least 0.9.

alr.supra.dropped.definition: Count where a candidate-gold link was not produced.

alr.supra.wrong_target.definition: Count where predicted and candidate-gold base targets differ.

alr.supra.hallucinated.definition: Count where a predicted link exists but candidate gold has none under benchmark rules.

alr.supra.anchor_error.definition: Count where base target agrees but fragment/anchor differs.

alr.supra.missing.definition: Count of benchmark-defined missing expected or predicted link conditions.

contracts.gold_creation: Candidate labels were derived from production/frozen splitter context and origin links, with auto/agent statuses and URL-existence checks.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: No current rows have independently accepted human authority-and-pinpoint truth. URL existence does not prove the cited authority. The rederive path applies only partial link gating, and 513 normalized texts are duplicates.
contracts.failure_semantics: Current outcomes are agreement with weak/self-derived candidates, not link correctness.
contracts.uncertainty: No valid uncertainty against true targets.
required_validation: Create occurrence-level human gold for cited authority, target URL, and pinpoint separately.
Verify target identity from authoritative metadata, not URL existence alone.
Apply full link-truth gating to every scheme and status.
Deduplicate normalized footnote text and work-family/pstream sources.
Blind adjudicators to production and candidate output.

alr.fields.type_accuracy.definition: Proposed fraction of parts with correct adjudicated authority type.

alr.fields.authority_identity_accuracy.definition: Proposed fraction of parts mapped to the correct canonical authority identity.

alr.fields.pinpoint_accuracy.definition: Proposed fraction of citation occurrences with an exact or adjudicated-equivalent pinpoint.

alr.fields.provisional_agreement.*.definition: Current agreement with values in field_gold_provisional.jsonl.

contracts.gold_creation: Fields inherit auto/agent values from pipeline outputs; no accepted per-field adjudication exists.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Current source is provisional and self-derived.
contracts.failure_semantics: Agreement with provisional fields is not correctness.
contracts.uncertainty: Undefined.
required_validation: Define field-level schemas and equivalence rules.
Independently adjudicate every scored field with accepted human provenance.
Record not-applicable and ambiguous separately from missing.
Freeze canonical authority identity and pinpoint normalization.

alr.a2aj_anchor.quote_match_score.definition: Heuristic normalized quote-match similarity used for anchor acceptance, commonly with threshold 0.98.

alr.a2aj_anchor.coverage.definition: Fraction of audited rows for which the heuristic produced an acceptable anchor.

alr.a2aj_anchor.hits.definition: Count of heuristic quote matches meeting its configured threshold.

alr.a2aj_anchor.page_references.definition: Count of outputs with a page reference under the audit rules.

alr.a2aj_ceiling.status_gained.definition: Count where candidate status rank is above frozen workbook baseline rank.

alr.a2aj_ceiling.status_lost.definition: Count where candidate status rank is below frozen workbook baseline rank.

alr.a2aj_ceiling.exact_lock.definition: Count whose candidate A2AJ output equals the frozen baseline lock fields.

alr.a2aj_ceiling.mutations.definition: Count or categories of candidate changes from frozen baseline values.

alr.a2aj_ceiling.authored_pinpoint_agree.definition: Agreement of candidate page/paragraph outputs with authored pinpoint text under replay normalization.

contracts.gold_creation: Heuristic quote matching and frozen workbook baselines.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The same heuristic determines hits; baseline workbook values are not adjudicated authority/page truth.
contracts.failure_semantics: Values describe heuristic availability or baseline change, not correctness.
contracts.uncertainty: No truth-based uncertainty.
contracts.interpretation: Diagnostic only; correctness metrics are absent.
required_validation: Create human authority, quote-span, page, paragraph, and pinpoint truth.
Validate thresholds on a disjoint set.
Separate retrieval availability from pinpoint correctness.

alr.a2aj_corpus.paragraph_medium_availab.definition: Fraction satisfying heuristic paragraph-index availability, quote-span score at least 0.05, and median words at least 12.

alr.a2aj_corpus.paragraph_high_availabil.definition: Fraction satisfying heuristic paragraph-index availability, quote-span score at least 0.10, and median words at least 20.

alr.a2aj_corpus.explicit_page_sequence_a.definition: Fraction whose structure data contains an explicit page sequence under the audit rule.

alr.a2aj_page_marker.consecutive_sequenc.definition: Count of regex marker sequences of length at least two.

alr.a2aj_page_marker.documents_with_two_.definition: Count of dataset/language/style detail rows with at least two-marker sequences; despite the field name, one document may contribute multiple rows.

alr.a2aj_structure.gained_lost_changed_s.definition: Counts of parser-transition categories comparing current and older heuristics.

alr.a2aj_structure.throughput.definition: Processed structure items or documents divided by elapsed time.

alr.a2aj_structure.extrapolated_full_min.definition: Measured per-item time extrapolated to a hard-coded corpus size of 328350.

contracts.gold_creation: Regex, heuristic, parser-comparison, and timing audits.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Availability rules are defined by the audited parser/regex; old-vs-new changes have no truth arm.
contracts.scorer: ALR A2AJ corpus, marker, structure, and performance audits
contracts.failure_semantics: These metrics describe corpus/parser observability and performance only.
contracts.uncertainty: No representative sampling or repeated timing.
required_validation: Correct the documents_with_two_marker_sequences label or aggregate by unique document.
Report corpus revision and denominator for every rate.
Use independently labelled markers/structure for correctness claims.

toa.analysis.reviewed_citation_occurrenc.definition: Number of citation occurrences examined by ToA analysis.

toa.analysis.canonical_authorities.definition: Number of canonical authority records produced after application normalization/deduplication.

toa.analysis.unresolved_references.definition: Number of references left unresolved by the application.

toa.analysis.part_links.definition: Number or mapping of citation parts assigned a link by the application.

toa.manifest.placeholder_count.definition: Count of PDF-origin placeholders recorded in the project manifest.

toa.manifest.source_text_length.definition: Character length of stored source text.

toa.manifest.discrepancy_count.definition: Number of quote/source comparisons below the application's discrepancy threshold.

contracts.gold_creation: Direct counts of application outputs.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The application defines the objects being counted.
contracts.failure_semantics: Unresolved and discrepancy states are workflow outcomes, not adjudicated errors.
contracts.uncertainty: Counts are exact for a run; no accuracy uncertainty.
required_validation: Report input and software hashes.
Do not infer recall from reviewed, authority, resolved, or unresolved counts.

toa.discrepancy.match_score.definition: Maximum SequenceMatcher ratio between normalized alphanumeric quoted words and source windows of target length plus or minus two words.

toa.discrepancy.candidate_accepted.definition: Boolean that match_score is at least 0.70.

toa.discrepancy.highlighted.definition: Boolean that match_score is at least 0.86.

contracts.gold_creation: Expected quote text comes from proposition extraction rather than an independently adjudicated source span.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Thresholds and expected strings are application heuristics; match_score is neither probability nor correctness.
contracts.failure_semantics: Threshold crossings are review-routing signals only.
contracts.uncertainty: No threshold calibration or confidence intervals.
required_validation: Create human-labelled quote/source span pairs and hard negatives.
Tune thresholds on training data and evaluate once on a disjoint holdout.
Report precision, recall, and calibration by discrepancy type.

toa.accuracy.authority_precision.definition: Proposed correctly produced canonical authorities divided by produced authorities.

toa.accuracy.authority_recall.definition: Proposed correctly produced canonical authorities divided by all adjudicated authorities.

toa.accuracy.occurrence_precision.definition: Proposed correctly extracted citation occurrences divided by produced occurrences.

toa.accuracy.occurrence_recall.definition: Proposed correctly extracted citation occurrences divided by adjudicated occurrences.

toa.accuracy.link_target.definition: Proposed fraction of linked occurrences with the correct canonical authority target.

toa.accuracy.pinpoint.definition: Proposed fraction of occurrences with an adjudicated-equivalent pinpoint.

toa.accuracy.pdf_retrieval.definition: Proposed fraction of retrieved PDFs that are the correct authority and version.

toa.accuracy.roundtrip_text_conservation.definition: Proposed fraction of immutable source text spans preserved exactly after ToA processing.

contracts.gold_creation: No frozen accepted ToA benchmark bundle is present.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Interactive user review exists, but no versioned benchmark labels, reviewer provenance, or independent holdout contract exists.
contracts.scorer: not implemented as an auditable benchmark
contracts.failure_semantics: Undefined until matching, equivalence, abstention, and ambiguity rules are frozen.
contracts.uncertainty: Undefined.
required_validation: Freeze occurrence spans, canonical authority IDs, target documents/versions, links, and pinpoints.
Store human provenance and adjudicate disagreements.
Define matching for aliases, parallel citations, multiple valid links, and ambiguous pinpoints.
Freeze immutable source spans independently of application output.
Use a held-out one-pstream, de-duplicated corpus.

footnote_goldset.scorecard.precision.definition: Correct predicted marker-body pairs divided by predicted pairs under the scorecard's identity rules.

footnote_goldset.scorecard.recall.definition: Correct predicted marker-body pairs divided by locked gold pairs under the scorecard's identity rules.

footnote_goldset.scorecard.f1.definition: Harmonic mean of pairing precision and recall.

footnote_goldset.lock.validation_issue_c.definition: Number of structural lock validation issues.

contracts.gold_creation: A hard-examples-first corpus was materialized from canonical automatic pages plus manual, completion, and visual repairs, then structurally locked.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The whole locked set mixes 303 manual_gold_locked pages with 1223 gold_locked pages and sources most markers from canonical automatic pages. Lock validity proves internal consistency, not independent semantic correctness.
contracts.scorer: Text-Fidelity footnote scorecard and lock validators
contracts.failure_semantics: Zero validation issues proves schema/lock consistency. Whole-set precision/recall are not human-gold accuracy until provenance-restricted.
contracts.uncertainty: Hard-examples-first selection supports regression case-set results, not population inference.
contracts.interpretation: Lock counts are valid invariants; whole-set accuracy is not currently proven.
required_validation: Score only rows with independently verifiable manual_gold_locked provenance, or independently adjudicate the automatic remainder.
Confirm exact marker/pair/page ID bijection and zero validation issues.
Deduplicate source pages and work families and enforce one upstream pstream.
Publish provenance-stratified metrics and label them hard-example case-set accuracy.
Never report population confidence intervals for this selection design.

document_intelligence.immutable_line_con.definition: Proposed exact preservation rate of independently identified immutable source lines.

document_intelligence.footnote_marker_bo.definition: Proposed precision of marker-to-body pair predictions.
Proposed recall of marker-to-body pair predictions.
Proposed harmonic mean of marker-body precision and recall.

document_intelligence.proposition_pairin.definition: Proposed fraction of footnotes paired to the correct adjudicated proposition span.

document_intelligence.docx_recovery_accu.definition: Proposed exact or equivalence-rule correctness of reconstructed DOCX structure/content.

document_intelligence.downstream_exact_f.definition: Proposed fraction of reconstructed footnotes that exactly retrieve the intended downstream record.

document_intelligence.application_equiva.definition: Proposed fraction of application-observable outputs equivalent to a frozen expected output under explicit rules.

document_intelligence.cost_per_document.definition: Proposed model and compute cost divided by completed documents under a frozen price schedule.

contracts.gold_creation: Plans call for a manual ordered gold bundle and downstream equivalence fixtures; the ordered bundle is missing and no complete downstream truth bundle exists.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Current local baselines, DOCX extraction, automatic canonical pages, and application outputs are not independent end-to-end truth.
contracts.scorer: proposed in document-intelligence and DOCX benchmark plans
contracts.failure_semantics: Undefined until identities, equivalence, abstentions, and ambiguous cases are specified.
contracts.uncertainty: Undefined until sample design exists.
required_validation: Build one versioned gold bundle that joins source work/pstream, rendered pages, lines, regions, markers, bodies, propositions, citations, authorities, links, and pinpoints by immutable IDs.
Require human provenance and adjudication for semantic labels.
Keep extraction truth independent from the candidate parser.
Freeze downstream expected outputs and equivalence rules.
Use a representative holdout for population claims and a separate challenge set for regression.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.accepted_gold_rows.definition: Number of rows admitted after excluding only needs_review and provisional; the field name is stronger than the actual filter.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.conservative.exact.definition: Admitted rows whose conservative parts equal a canonical or accepted-alternative partition after normalization.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.conservative.under.definition: Non-exact conservative rows with fewer parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.conservative.over_.definition: Non-exact conservative rows with more parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.conservative.bound.definition: Non-exact conservative rows with the canonical part count.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.conservative.absta.definition: Rows where the conservative splitter status is not deterministic_complete.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.recall_first.exact.definition: Admitted rows whose recall-first parts equal a canonical or accepted-alternative partition after normalization.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.recall_first.under.definition: Non-exact recall-first rows with fewer parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.recall_first.over_.definition: Non-exact recall-first rows with more parts than the canonical partition.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.recall_first.bound.definition: Non-exact recall-first rows with the canonical part count.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.replacement_eligib.definition: Count of deterministic-complete rows with non-empty parts, complete extracted fields, and no supra/ibid token.

legalpdf.alr_splitter.recall_first_chara.definition: Recall-first rows whose source and joined output differ after removing whitespace and semicolons.

contracts.gold_creation: The legacy compatibility runner reads the ALR review product but uses a denylist status filter.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Unknown, auto, agent, rejected, or blank statuses are admitted. Human provenance and normalized-content uniqueness are not checked; under/over uses only canonical count.
contracts.failure_semantics: Compatibility outcomes cannot be promoted to gold accuracy under the current loader.
contracts.uncertainty: No representative sampling or interval.
contracts.interpretation: Current output is an untrusted compatibility diagnostic.
required_validation: Replace the denylist with exact accepted plus required human provenance.
Require unique IDs, normalized-content fingerprints, and one upstream pstream per work.
Require exact gold/prediction coverage.
Use the min/max accepted partition counts for under/over.
Require character neutrality for exact outcomes.

alr.smoke.documents.definition: Number of input documents processed by the deterministic smoke run.

alr.smoke.footnotes.definition: Number of extracted footnotes in the smoke run.

alr.smoke.parts.definition: Number of citation parts emitted in the smoke run.

alr.smoke.reference_parts.definition: Number of emitted parts classified as references by the application.

alr.smoke.linked_reference_parts.definition: Reference-classified parts with a non-empty link.

alr.smoke.character_failures.definition: Footnotes whose application-defined source/output core invariant fails.

alr.smoke.reference_method_counts.*.definition: Frequency of application-defined reference resolution methods.

alr.live_hybrid.split_invocations.definition: Number of calls into the split function, including cache or deterministic outcomes.

alr.live_hybrid.live_split_calls.definition: Usage-log records added while executing split calls.

alr.live_hybrid.live_disambiguation_call.definition: Usage-log records added during disambiguation calls.

alr.live_hybrid.pure_reference_replaceme.definition: Count where the pure-reference prefilter returned a replacement.

alr.live_hybrid.deterministic_tuple_repl.definition: Count where the deterministic footnote-parts function returned a replacement.

alr.live_hybrid.live_calls.definition: Total usage-log records in the run.

alr.live_hybrid.other_live_calls.definition: live_calls minus live_split_calls and live_disambiguation_calls, floored at zero.

alr.live_hybrid.elapsed_s.definition: Wall-clock duration of build_audit_data for one arm.

alr.live_hybrid.footnotes.definition: Number of extracted input footnote records.

alr.live_hybrid.cache_files_before.definition: Count of JSON files in the configured cache directory before the run.

alr.live_hybrid.cache_files_after.definition: Count of JSON files in the configured cache directory after the run.

alr.live_hybrid.reference_methods.*.definition: Frequency of non-empty application reference-resolution method strings.

contracts.gold_creation: Direct instrumentation and output counts.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: The application defines classifications, replacements, methods, and usage records. Linked is not correct; cache-file count is not cache-hit count.
contracts.failure_semantics: Only crashes and explicit character-invariant violations are failures of a stated contract; all other values are operational observations.
contracts.uncertainty: One run, no repeated timing or model stochasticity estimate.
required_validation: Pin source, software, model, cache, and environment hashes.
Do not treat linked, replacement, or method counts as correctness.
Use repeated runs for latency and token distributions.

alr.hybrid_pair.partition_exact.definition: Footnotes whose normalized part sequences are equal between two replay arms.

alr.hybrid_pair.partition_under.definition: Footnotes where the right replay arm has fewer parts than the left arm.

alr.hybrid_pair.partition_over.definition: Footnotes where the right replay arm has more parts than the left arm.

alr.hybrid_pair.partition_boundary.definition: Footnotes with equal part count but unequal normalized sequences across arms.

alr.hybrid_pair.left_character_failures.definition: Left-arm outputs that fail the replay core-character invariant.

alr.hybrid_pair.right_character_failures.definition: Right-arm outputs that fail the replay core-character invariant.

alr.hybrid_pair.aligned_parts.definition: Normalized part texts present in both arm dictionaries; duplicate normalized parts can overwrite.

alr.hybrid_pair.field_equal.*.definition: Count of aligned parts where the named field is exactly equal across arms.

alr.hybrid_pair.link_outcomes.*.definition: Application-defined link-change outcomes between two replay arms.

alr.hybrid_pair.full_split_calls_saved.definition: Left full-split fallback count minus right full-split fallback count.

alr.hybrid_arm.full_split_calls.definition: Number of fallback records in an arm.

alr.hybrid_arm.history_changed_fallbacks.definition: Fallback records whose generated history differs from the replay's expected history.

alr.hybrid_arm.history_changed_reference.definition: History-changed fallbacks classified as reference footnotes.

alr.hybrid_arm.recorded_live_calls_avoid.definition: Frozen usage-log call records attached to deterministically replaced footnotes.

alr.hybrid_arm.recorded_tokens_avoided.*.definition: Frozen recorded token totals attached to deterministically replaced footnotes.

alr.reference_replay.replaced_footnotes.definition: Number of footnotes replaced under the replay policy.

alr.reference_replay.economy_replaced_fo.definition: Number of footnotes replaced under the economy replay policy.

alr.reference_replay.paid_fallback_calls.definition: Configured/replayed paid fallback call count; current deterministic replay reports zero.

alr.reference_replay.material_link_chang.definition: Count of link fields materially changed between replay arms.

alr.supra_fallback.scores.*.definition: Counts of correct, unresolved, wrong, recovered, and method outcomes versus self-derived supra candidate links for each fallback variant.

alr.supra_fallback.changed_cases.definition: Number of cases where any fallback variant outcome differs from strict resolver outcome.

alr.supra_fallback.inferred_short_form_i.definition: Count of inferred short forms by inference rule.

alr.supra_fallback.inferred_short_form_c.definition: Count of normalized inferred short forms associated with multiple base links under the audit rule.

contracts.gold_creation: Paired replay outputs and frozen usage records; supra outcomes additionally compare with weak self-derived candidates.
contracts.independence_and_leakage: Arm agreement and frozen usage are not truth. Supra correct/wrong labels inherit the non-independent candidate set. Normalized-part dictionaries can overwrite duplicates.
contracts.scorer: ALR high-accuracy hybrid, deterministic reference replay, and supra fallback tools
contracts.failure_semantics: Values describe behavior deltas, projected avoided work, or candidate-link agreement.
contracts.uncertainty: No live-model variance or population sampling.
contracts.interpretation: Compatibility and projected operational diagnostics; embedded supra correctness labels are NOT SCOREABLE.
required_validation: Do not label cross-arm equality or candidate-link agreement accuracy.
De-duplicate normalized parts before aligned-field comparisons.
Confirm avoided-call projections with a randomized live shadow run.
Use independently adjudicated target/pinpoint gold for supra correctness.
